name: Safe Portable Camping Stove
description:
Take your outdoor cooking to the next level with this Foldable Portable Gas Stove, designed for camping, hiking, backpacking, and other outdoor adventures. Compact, lightweight, and safe, it’s the perfect companion for all your outdoor meals.

Key Features:

Simple Operation: Easy to use and clean, making outdoor cooking hassle-free.

Electronic Ignition Device: Quick and safe ignition with a voltage ceramic type for fast lighting and extinguishing.

Stable Bottom Tripod: Foldable tripod design provides excellent stability, preventing slips during cooking.

Serrated Support: Low center of gravity with serrated support improves friction between stove and cookware for added safety.

Versatile Application: Ideal for camping, hiking, backpacking, mountaineering, fishing, snow, and other outdoor activities.

Specifications:

Item Type: Foldable Camping Stove

Material: Stainless Steel + Aluminum Alloy

Color: Silver + Orange

Weight: Approx. 386–418g (13.6–14.7 oz)

Package Includes:

1x Portable Gas Stove with Folding Tripod

Storage Bag for Easy Transport

Suitable for Cooking, Picnic, and Outdoor Adventures

Enjoy safe, stable, and convenient outdoor cooking with this Foldable Portable Gas Stove—lightweight, compact, and ready for any adventure.
